citation.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Model-Based Optimization Method for Graphic Design

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The paper reports graphic-design computation time and classification metrics against MDP, VR and AI labels, without evaluating a classical topology optimizer.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No classical TO runtime comparison; Table 3 reports percentages for generic graphic-design methods.
claim.alternatives: §7, p. 132 qualitatively contrasts neural density representation with voxel-based optimization, but gives no classical TO cost or result.

baseline.hardware_ml: 64-bit Intel Xeon Gold CPU at 2.10 GHz (§5, p. 129)
baseline.ml_time: 61% relative computation-time entry in Table 3, p. 130; abstract states 61 s without identifying a classical TO run
baseline.quality_metric: graphic-design accuracy, precision and recall (Tables 4–6, pp. 130–132)

notes: §4 describes density-field topology optimization and mentions SIMP, but §5 gives only generic graphic-design metrics for MDP, VR and AI comparisons.
